_help: Web Developer track. Self-contained: 'id', 'label', 'icon' (Font Awesome name) and 'order' control the tab button. 'badges' (OPTIONAL): logo buttons under the role; each is {logo, label, url} OR {icon (Font Awesome classes, e.g. 'fa-brands fa-github'), label, url}. 'icon' also auto-fills if the logo image fails. If 'url' is omitted the badge is not a link. Every project's 'media' is OPTIONAL and can be a single object or an array. Media types: 'image', 'gif' (both render as ), 'video' (autoplay loop muted), 'loom' (iframe embed). Empty/missing src or no 'media' = text-only project.

title: Web Developer
bio: I build fast, usable web tools — scrapers, bots, proxies, CLI utilities. Focused on modern UIs and practical automation. I use AI where it helps with prototyping and scripting, but ship clean, maintainable code.

stack.label: Backend
stack.value: Node.js / Express · Flask · REST APIs · Jinja

projects.title: Web Scraper API
projects.description: REST API that scrapes and normalizes data from multiple sources and returns clean JSON. Implemented in both Node.js and Python (Flask), with rate-limiting and error handling.

projects.title: Proxy Embed
projects.description: Custom reverse proxy to handle and reroute web traffic securely. Handles headers, CORS, and rewrite rules without leaking origin.

projects.title: Telegram & Facebook Chatbots
projects.description: Conversational bots using platform APIs for real-time commands, notifications, and task handling. Built in Node.js and Python, deployed with webhooks.

projects.title: Audio Converter CLI
projects.description: Terminal tool for batch-converting and compressing audio files. Built in Python, focused on speed and small output size with simple flags.

projects.title: Neth Orion DDOS
projects.description: Network stress-testing tool built for cybersecurity research. It simulates high-concurrency traffic in an isolated lab environment to analyze server resilience and evaluate the effectiveness of rate-limiting and DDoS mitigation defenses.
